options.content: **Interpretacja:** `packet_ota_tx` = kolejne nadania tego samego `packet_id` (w tym rebroadcasty meshtasticd). `link_attempt` = pojedynczy skok RF (TX→RX). Pełna trasa ≈ sekwencja TX + zgodne krawędzie RF w czasie. To nie jest oficjalna tabela routingu firmware.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${packet_id}" != "")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "tx_node"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.packet_id and string(v: r.packet_id) == "${packet_id}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "tx_node", "is_rebroadcast", "hop_limit", "hop_start"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.delivered == "True")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${packet_id}" != "")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "tx_node", "rx_node"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.packet_id and string(v: r.packet_id) == "${packet_id}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "tx_node", "rx_node", "rssi_db", "snr_db"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${packet_id}" != "")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => string(v: r._value) == "${packet_id}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "tx_node"])
  |> rename(columns: {tx_node: "krok"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "is_rebroadcast")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == true)
  |> group(columns: ["tx_node"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 30)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "tx_node"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.is_rebroadcast and r.is_rebroadcast == false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "hop_limit"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "tx_node"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.is_rebroadcast and r.is_rebroadcast == true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "hop_limit"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Średni hop_limit: pierwszy TX vs rebroadcast

targets.query:
from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.portnum == "TRACEROUTE_APP")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["tx_node"])
  |> last()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "packet_id"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.delivered == "True")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["tx_node", "rx_node"])
  |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "dostarczenia"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["dostarczenia"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
